We need other scenarios: blueprint with non-null schemaLoadersBuilder, non-null schemaMappersBuilder; blueprint with empty metaSchemas; blueprint with null defaultMetaSchemaIri; blueprint with null jsonMapper/yamlMapper/jsonNodeReader; blueprint with metaSchemas having multiple entries including IRI needing normalization (e.g., with trailing slash); blueprint where metaSchemas map contains duplicate normalized keys; blueprint where metaSchemas contains null entry?
